description.value: Woodstone Pizza is a Neapolitan-style pizzeria in Chilliwack making wood-fired pies on a sourdough crust from a family recipe passed down for generations. The kitchen uses premium ingredients including fior di latte, hand-stretched dough, and prosciutto cotto, with a menu spanning classic Italian specialties and local-style combinations. The restaurant is currently open and operating normally while a full rebrand is in progress.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 59m; stands (6 spaces) at 65m; stands (6 spaces) at 66m; stands (1 space) at 83m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Woodstone Pizza is fully open at 9259 Young Rd, Chilliwack, undergoing a rebrand but still operating with the same menu and Woodstone oven. Two phone numbers appear on the website (+1 604 392 7209 and +1 604 392 2888); OSM had no phone. The website address shows unit '1104' while OSM addr:unit says '104' — a discrepancy flagged below. Takeout and delivery are confirmed via explicit 'Pick Up & Take Out' section and third-party delivery platform mentions; no mention of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site.
concerns: Unit number mismatch: OSM addr:unit is '104' but website consistently shows '1104' (full address: 1104, 9259 Young Rd). OSM may have a data entry error.
OSM has no phone number; two numbers sourced from website only: +1 604-392-7209 and +1 604-392-2888.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open pizza restaurant confirmed by active website and current menu. Good refuelling stop for touring cyclists in Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.notes: Delivery also available via SkipTheDishes and Uber Eats per website. Rebrand in progress but business is fully operational.
